messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'm about to roll out the new client-side header adapter for feature gating today. Default is OFF. Planning a canary for 2% iOS mobile (v2.3+) and 1% Android (v2.3+). Patching config now, PTAL if I missed anything.

anya: Quick Q — how are we encoding the SDK version in the header? semver in `x-client-version`?

sam: yep, we expect `x-client-version` with semver. Adapter parses major.minor and requires >= 2.3. We handle prerelease by ignoring it for now.

matt: For backcompat — older SDKs won't send the header. We should NOT enable for header-missing clients. Prefer explicit header check over heuristics (UA).

sam: agreed. New rule: only enable when `x-client-version` is present AND >= 2.3. No UA fallbacks. Canary audience config will explicitly target device+version buckets.

lisa: Add a guardrail: automatic rollback if error-rate delta > 2% or latency p95 increases > 200ms. Who owns the rollback automation?

kevin: eng-oncall owns the automation hooks. I'll add a rollout policy that includes metric thresholds and an automatic rollback action. @sam can you tag the flag correctly so I can reference it?

sam: will tag the flag `client-adapter-v1-canary` and annotate `canary-audience: mobile-2pct-ios, mobile-1pct-android`. Also adding telemetry event `adapter_eval` with fields `success`, `latency_ms`, `reason`.

ci-bot: Deploy scheduled by @sam — canary rollout at 2026-04-05T18:00:00Z. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/1768501234

anya: Code review ping: PR #4283 — please review the header parsing tests and the unit for `2.3` vs `2.3.0` comparison. I added a failing case for `2.3-alpha`.

matt: One more ask: SDK should log (INFO) why the gate was skipped: `header_missing` vs `version_too_old` vs `flag_disabled` so support can triage without guessing.

sam: good call. I'll add `event.reason` with values `header_missing|version_too_old|disabled_by_flag`. Also emitting `event.client_version` so we can see distribution.

lisa: Can we add a short devex doc explaining how to run the adapter locally and how to simulate canary audiences? Even a 1-paragraph and a curl example would help.

sam: adding docs under `docs/sdk/feature-gates.md`. Example snippet I'll include: ```bash
curl -H "x-client-version: 2.3.1" -H "x-rw-gate-adapter: enable" https://api.redwood.test/gate-check
```

kevin: Rollout plan proposal: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 24h holds between stages, full rollout after 48h of no regressions. Sound good?

anya: +1 from me. I'll schedule the stage timers in the console.

sam: thanks everyone. tagging @eng-oncall for monitoring handoff :thumbsup: 

matt: left a small comment in the PR about splitting parsing logic into a helper for easier unit tests.

lisa: I'll follow up with a short support note for CS to explain the header and how to interpret logs.

sam: done — PR updated, docs stub added, telemetry event instrumented. Will kick the canary at 18:00 UTC and monitor the dashboard.

ci-bot: Canary rollout started. Link: https://console.redwood/rollouts/1768501234

kevin: Monitoring: p95 latency +40ms, error-rate +0.4% for canary so far. Within thresholds.

sam: great — keeping a 4h watch window, will report back or roll forward per the staged plan.
